title: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model
layout_note: Three lettered panels: A is a tall top-to-bottom search tree filling the left half; B (acting) and C (training) are wide left-to-right time chains stacked in the right half. Large sans letters A, B, C sit in each panel's top-left corner.
grouping: No containers or background fills: the panels are divided only by thin light-grey rules (one vertical, one horizontal). Grouping is by colour family: the representation function h and the state it produces are blue, the dynamics function g and its states and rewards green, the prediction function f and its policy/value outputs pink-magenta, and the search-tree nodes off the highlighted path are light grey.
shapes_depth: Flat line art without boxes, shadows or 3-D. Hidden states are circles with a pale tint fill and a darker same-hue outline (pale blue s0, pale green s1 to s3); unexpanded tree nodes are pale grey circles on grey edges. Observations are small Go-board icons (a grid crossing with black and white stones) that gain a stone per time step in B and C. The search policy pi is a small green bar chart inside square vector brackets; in B a miniature grey arrow tree under each board feeds a thick grey gradient arrow down to that bar chart. Solid grey arrows mark environment steps, dashed grey arrows past and future, coloured arrows the learned functions. Function names are bold italic letters on their arrows; superscripted math (s^k, r^k, a^k, p^k, v^k) labels nodes and edges.
proposed_highlight: There are no module boxes or names. The three learned functions are single bold italic letters (h, g, f), and each has one colour that is reused for its arrow, its letter, and the state or outputs it produces, the same way in A and in C. In A only the unrolled model path is drawn in colour while the rest of the search tree is greyed out, so the learned-model path stands out against its search context.
lesson: Give each learned function one colour and paint its letter, its arrow and its output in it across every panel, so the same model is recognisable both as a path through a search tree (A) and as a straight unrolled chain (C).
notes: Panel C redraws panel A's state circles and colours as a horizontal chain, with actions a_t+k rising into each g from the observation timeline drawn underneath. The crop is one embedded raster (its images_px record covers the whole figure), so measured.photo_share is null and the palette is taken from all ink. Venue as recorded from Semantic Scholar; year = arXiv preprint year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: the same three learned functions h, g, f drawn three ways - a search tree of hidden states (A), acting in the environment over three steps (B), and training the model unrolled over the same steps (C) - each function in its own colour across all panels

relations.form: panel C unrolls the model in a row: board icon up through cyan h into s0, then green g steps to s1 and s2, each g taking an action a_{t+1}, a_{t+2} from the board row below, with pink f lifting p, v above every state

panel A draws the search on a tree: a Go board at the top through h into s0, green g edges labelled a, r down one branch through s1, s2, s3, pink f giving p, v at each node, and unexplored nodes pale grey

panel B runs left to right over three board states joined by u_{t+1}, u_{t+2}, u_{t+3}; under each a small grey search tree yields a green policy histogram pi whose curved arrow chooses the next action
B and C stack on the right, aligned on the same three time steps, so acting (top) and training (bottom) compare column by column

channels.colour: cyan = representation h and s0; green = dynamics g and the states s1..s3 it produces, and also the policy histograms pi in B; pink = prediction f and its outputs p, v; pale grey = unexplored tree nodes; dark grey = environment flow
channels.shape: circles = hidden states; Go-board icons = observations; bracketed bar histograms = policies; single italic letters = functions
channels.line: solid coloured arrows = learned-function steps; grey arrows = environment transitions; dashed grey = earlier / later time
channels.frame: no frames; a vertical and a horizontal rule split the three panels

quality.strengths: one colour per learned function, held across all three panels, makes the tree, the acting loop and the training unroll readable as the same model; hidden states are drawn as nouns (s0..s3 circles) between the functions; the training unroll in C is aligned under the acting row in B on the same time steps
quality.weaknesses: green also fills the policy histograms in B, which are search outputs not dynamics; the functions are only single italic letters, so h/g/f must be learned from the caption; the small grey search trees in B are too small to read as the panel-A tree

insights.structure: Three panels: A (left, full height) a search tree, B (top right) acting in the environment over three time steps, C (bottom right) the unrolled training of the model aligned with the same steps; a vertical rule and a horizontal rule split them.
insights.data: Board states are tiny Go-board icons, hidden states are circles labelled s0..s3, policies are green bar histograms in brackets, and functions are single italic letters h, g, f.
insights.emphasis: Each function has its own colour carried across panels: cyan for h (representation), green for g (dynamics) and its s nodes, pink for f outputs p,v, while unexplored tree nodes are pale grey.
insights.flow: A reads top-down along the green path of the tree; B and C read left to right along a dashed-in timeline, with C's h arrow rising from the board row to s0 and g arrows conditioned on actions coming up from below.

arrangement.units: three unboxed panels lettered A, B, C separated by thin rules
arrangement.inputs_as: Go-board state icons on a horizontal timeline
arrangement.shared: the same h/g/f colour code and s-node glyphs across all panels
